## Domain analysis and decisions

### Purpose and critical data (`purpose`)

Identify consumers, critical elements, error consequences, and acceptable risk.

> Enter project evidence, conclusion, and owner.


### Dimensions and versioned rules (`rules`)

Fix population, denominator, exceptions, threshold, measurement point, approval, and effective date per rule.

> Enter project evidence, conclusion, and owner.


### Profiling and baseline (`baseline`)

Record sampling windows and defect rates for stock, flow, source, and consumption points.

> Enter project evidence, conclusion, and owner.


### Business impact and priority (`impact`)

Link defect samples to loss, decision risk, and remediation benefit.

> Enter project evidence, conclusion, and owner.


### Root cause and recurrence test (`root_cause`)

Test root-cause hypotheses with process, interface, or source evidence.

> Enter project evidence, conclusion, and owner.


### Prevention detection and correction (`prevention`)

Prevent at creation, detect in flow, and audit historical repair.

> Enter project evidence, conclusion, and owner.


### Issue closure and scorecard (`scorecard`)

Set SLA, trends, exception expiry, retesting, and business benefit.

> Enter project evidence, conclusion, and owner.


### Gates and acceptance (`acceptance_evidence`)

Verify root-cause control, recurrence trend, and residual exceptions with evidence.

> Enter project evidence, conclusion, and owner.
